set.body: Add a cross-built AR/ARMA whitening-plan core for ScalaFIM. Scope: immutable WhiteningPlan, AR/ARMA coefficients, pooling/segment metadata, run/censor segment construction, and pure plan application to design/data matrices. Acceptance: AR(1), AR(2), and ARMA(1,1) whitening match manual recursion; run boundaries and censor gaps reset recursions; JVM and Scala.js tests pass.
set.title: Slice 13: AR whitening plan core
